summary.en-US: Hides YouTube Shorts from the home feed, subscriptions, search, sidebars and channel pages. No settings, no tracking, no data collected. Shorts links someone sends you still open normally.

description.en-US:
YouTube Shorts take over the home feed, search results and sidebar. No Shorts removes them so you can browse YouTube without getting pulled into the endless scroll.

What gets hidden:
• Shorts shelves on the home and subscriptions feeds
• Shorts shelves and Shorts results in search
• Shorts in the watch-page sidebar and notifications
• The Shorts entry in the sidebar and mini sidebar
• The Shorts tab on channel pages
• The Shorts filter on search results

What stays:
• All regular videos
• Direct Shorts links someone sends you still open normally

Shorts are hidden before the page is drawn, so they never flash on screen.

Privacy: No Shorts collects no data, makes no network requests and has no settings. It only runs on www.youtube.com.

Works in Firefox and Firefox-based browsers such as Zen.

version.approval_notes: No build step, bundling or minification: the uploaded package is the source (manifest.json, shorts.css, shorts.js, icons/icon.svg). shorts.css hides YouTube Shorts UI with CSS selectors. shorts.js only toggles a data-no-shorts attribute on YouTube's search filter chips whose label is 'Shorts' (or its ja/uk translations) so shorts.css can hide them; it uses a MutationObserver batched with requestAnimationFrame. No network requests, no storage, no permissions beyond the content script on www.youtube.com.
